recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, minimalist composition featuring a continuous, looping monolinear path and geometric, multi-line typography, all unified by a soft pastel gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: The looping line flows from the top right to the bottom center, creating a sense of organic movement against the rigid typography.
The gradient transition from cool blue to warm peach is applied consistently across both text and line art.
The typography is positioned in the center-left, acting as a stable anchor for the fluid line work.
coreInvariants: Uniform stroke weight for both the abstract line and the typographic characters.
Deep charcoal or near-black matte background.
Linear gradient spanning from light blue to soft pink/peach.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Typography is mid-left; abstract line occupies the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The geometric 'L' and 'Y' characters provide the primary structural focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the looping line from the top right, spiraling down towards the bottom, then moves left to read the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space emphasizes the delicacy of the thin lines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pastel gradient (blue to peach) for all foreground elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The transition point of the gradient (lavender/pink) acts as a soft focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation pastels against a high-value dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Characters are built from parallel, non-touching lines.
Stroke ends are flat and perpendicular to the path.
Uniform line weight matching the abstract graphic element.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' consists of two parallel right-angle lines.
The 'Y' is formed by three converging parallel lines.
The CJK character is rendered with simplified, uniform-width strokes to match the Latin characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monolinear abstract art paired with matching-weight geometric lettering.

candidateDirections.reason: To ensure the parallel line gaps remain consistent with the abstract graphic.
As a base for modification to create the double-line effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid dark charcoal background. Draw a single, continuous thin line that loops and spirals from the top right corner down to the bottom center. Apply a linear gradient to the line starting with light blue at the top, transitioning through lavender to peach at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a vector tool, create geometric uppercase letters using parallel thin lines. Position them in the center-left. Apply the same blue-to-peach linear gradient to the text so it matches the vertical color transition of the background line.

verificationChecks: Is the stroke weight identical for the text and the line?
Does the gradient flow smoothly across all elements?
Is the background a flat, dark matte color?
Are the letters constructed of parallel lines?

adjustableVariables: Spacing between parallel lines in the text
mustRedesign: Exact character sequences from the source
postGenerationChecks: Verify the gradient is linear and vertical.
Ensure the text is legible despite the multi-line construction.
Confirm the background is free of noise or texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark background + Monolinear abstract path + Parallel-line geometric typography + Unified pastel gradient.
